## What IGOR does

IGOR is a forum where members of the DGPs section Biological Psychology and Neuropsychology exchange ideas on how to make research in the field more open and reproducible. It works through grassroots community projects, training for early-career researchers and the annual IGOR Prize for Open and Reproducible Science. Its founding document (in German) is available [here](https://www.dgps.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Fachgruppen/Biologische_Psychologie_und_Neuropsychologie/PDF/IGOR_Gruendungsversion_21012020.pdf).

## BIDS Consultation Hour

In 2024 I set up the [IGOR BIDS Consultation Hour](https://igor-biodgps.github.io/igor_bids_consultation/), an open online forum. Researchers bring their own datasets and conversion problems and get individual advice on organising them in the [Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS)](https://bids.neuroimaging.io). I cover EEG and motion data, and a colleague covers MRI. The website also collects BIDS learning materials, such as workshop slides and posters.

## EEG/ERP preprocessing umbrella review

Together with Yu-Fang Yang, Mario Reutter-Dieker and Johannes Rodrigues, I co-lead an [umbrella review of EEG/ERP preprocessing practices](https://github.com/ufangYang/igor-preprocessing-umbrella-review). It brings together the literature on how preprocessing pipelines and parameters are reported and justified. The aim is a shared, transparent set of extraction standards and evidence the field can reuse. The review is [preregistered on OSF](https://osf.io/uqenv/) and complements my work on [reporting standards for mobile EEG](meta-rep.qmd).

## More from the IGOR community

- [**ARIADNE**](https://igor-biodgps.github.io/ARIADNE/intro.html) is a living, interactive navigator that guides researchers through the resources for each step of a transparent research project ([Hartmann et al., 2025](https://doi.org/10.1177/25152459241297674)). I contributed glossary terms during its revision.
- [**Enhancing precision in human neuroscience**](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.85980) is a community review on precision in human neuroscience ([Nebe et al., 2023](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.85980)), with an accompanying [workshop](https://github.com/IGOR-bioDGPs/precision_workshop_2024).
